profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer · Full-Stack Architecture & Engineering · Delivering High-Performance Web Applications · React · TypeScript · .NET Core · AWS
profile.summary:
I design and engineer software that performs under real-world pressure — across fintech, media, and enterprise platforms that serve millions of users.
Over 12 years I've worked at every layer of the stack: designing React and TypeScript component systems that cut development time by 40%, securing .NET Core microservices with OAuth2.0 and JWT, building cloud-native infrastructure on AWS, and integrating CI/CD pipelines that enforce quality automatically — including WCAG 2.1 accessibility compliance — before code ever reaches production.
I joined NCR Corporation's Digital Banking division and stayed through its $2.45B acquisition and rebrand as Candescent — now the largest independent digital banking platform in the US, serving 1,300+ financial institutions and 29M+ users. That continuity gave me something most engineers don't get: end-to-end ownership of a platform across a major acquisition, from the engineering decisions that made it valuable to the architecture decisions that kept it running after.
I lead teams, not just code. I mentor engineers, run structured code reviews, drive sprint planning, and sit at the table with product and UX to make sure what gets built is the right thing — not just the fastest thing.
What I bring to any team:
→ Full-stack architecture across React, TypeScript, .NET Core, Node.js, and AWS
→ A track record of measurable delivery — 40% faster UI development, 60% less boilerplate, 20% increase in user engagement
→ Engineering instincts built across fintech, legal tech, industrial, and enterprise software
→ The ability to lead both the technical roadmap and the people executing it
I'm based in Frisco, TX. Open to Lead and Principal Engineer roles where the problems are hard, the systems matter, and the team wants to build something that lasts.
Let's connect.

positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.description:
Candescent is the former NCR Voyix Digital Banking division, acquired by Veritas Capital for $2.45B and rebranded in 2024 — now the largest independent digital banking platform in the US, serving 1,300+ financial institutions and 29M+ users. I was there before and after the acquisition, and I lead the front-end engineering that powers it.

I own the UI architecture across the platform: designing the component system, setting the technical direction, and making sure every product surface meets the quality bar financial clients demand.

▸ Architected a React + TypeScript + Storybook component library that reduced UI development time by 40% across engineering teams
▸ Led migration from monolithic to microservices architecture for a 5-engineer team — improving deployment independence and system scalability
▸ Built an automated accessibility testing framework (Cypress + axe-core + GitHub Actions) that enforces WCAG 2.1 compliance as a CI/CD gate — zero manual review overhead
▸ Implemented RTK Query for server-state management, eliminating ~60% of frontend boilerplate and enabling automatic caching and real-time polling
▸ Delivered custom MUI theme system that cut styling redundancy by 30% and standardized brand consistency across all product surfaces
▸ Drove a UI redesign with the UX team that increased average time-on-site by 20%
▸ Led client-facing training for FI teams building custom UI extensions on the platform
▸ Mentor junior engineers through pair programming and code reviews — raising team-wide proficiency in state management and functional patterns

Stack: React, TypeScript, RTK Query, Redux Saga, React Native, MUI, Storybook, Cypress, GitHub Actions, Figma, Agile/Scrum

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
As a Senior Software Engineer, I was embedded in the front-end engineering of an enterprise fintech product, with a focus on building the reusable component infrastructure and accessible interfaces the platform relied on.

▸ Engineered enterprise frontend features using TypeScript, React, Redux Saga, and Material UI — contributing to a platform serving millions of end users
▸ Architected and maintained a custom React component library, standardizing UI patterns across multiple product teams and accelerating delivery velocity
▸ Championed accessibility as a technical discipline — led UI accessibility reviews and partnered with UX, product, and engineering to ship WCAG-compliant interfaces at scale
▸ Managed complex async application state with Redux Saga, improving reliability of critical data flows across the product

Stack: React, TypeScript, ES6+, Redux Saga, Material UI (MUI), RESTful APIs, GitHub, Agile/Scrum

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Thomson Reuters runs mission-critical legal, financial, and regulatory platforms used by professionals in 160+ countries. Engineering here means building for correctness, security, and scale — there is no tolerance for downtime or data errors.

In four years as a Senior Software Engineer, I delivered full-stack features across cloud-native AWS infrastructure and Angular/TypeScript front-ends, while taking on platform reliability and developer tooling ownership.

▸ Implemented REST APIs secured with OAuth2.0 and JWT using .NET Core, deployed via APIGEE gateway within a production microservices architecture
▸ Designed and maintained cloud-native AWS applications using Lambda, S3, SQS, EC2, Step Functions, IAM, and CloudWatch
▸ Established Datadog monitoring dashboards for real-time observability across distributed services and AWS infrastructure
▸ Integrated RabbitMQ for asynchronous inter-service messaging — decoupling components and improving system resilience
▸ Delivered unit and integration test coverage using xUnit and FitNesse; drove API performance testing with Grafana
▸ Built and optimized .NET Core middleware for authentication and exception handling
▸ Partnered with DevOps on Jenkins CI/CD pipeline implementation, reducing manual deployment overhead
▸ Collaborated directly with Business Analysts and Product Owners on backlog grooming, user story definition, and sprint planning

Stack: .NET Core, C#, REST Web API, Angular, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, AWS (Lambda/S3/SQS/EC2/Step Functions/CloudWatch/IAM), RabbitMQ, APIGEE, Datadog, Grafana, Jenkins, xUnit, Agile/Scrum

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
LCI Inc. is a Dallas-based technology solutions firm delivering custom enterprise software for mid-market and large-scale clients. This role was where I built the full-stack foundation that every senior role since has run on.

Over four years I worked across the full SDLC — from requirements and architecture through to deployment and security hardening — on multiple simultaneous enterprise projects.

▸ Replaced a legacy line-of-business web application with a modern responsive platform built on AngularJS, HTML5, Bootstrap, jQuery, and REST APIs — improving UX, cutting maintenance overhead, and directly increasing user adoption
▸ Built a Node.js Express server with Socket.io, delivering real-time broadcast and chat services via a full-stack MVC architecture spanning AngularJS frontend to MongoDB backend
▸ Implemented OAuth2.0 with JWT for Web API authentication and Single Sign-On (SSO), hardening the application's security posture for enterprise clients
▸ Developed ASP.NET, SharePoint, and C# modules using Entity Framework 4.5; engineered WCF service libraries to standardize data exchange between application layers and backend systems
▸ Analyzed penetration test results and source code security reviews; drove remediation decisions based on business risk appetite — an early foundation in security-first engineering
▸ Optimized SQL Server query performance by eliminating redundant joins, introducing clustered and non-clustered indexes, and applying regular expressions for pattern matching; reduced query overhead and trained junior developers in SQL best practices
▸ Managed delivery across sprint cycles using JIRA within an Agile/Scrum framework, building habits in structured velocity and stakeholder communication that carried through every role since

Stack: AngularJS, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap, jQuery, Node.js, Socket.io, REST APIs, OAuth2.0, JWT, SSO, ASP.NET, C#, SharePoint, Entity Framework 4.5, WCF, MongoDB, SQL Server, JIRA, Agile/Scrum

positions.title: Software Developer Intern (Summer)
positions.description:
DMG / Mori Seiki USA is the North American arm of DMG MORI — the world's largest manufacturer of high-precision CNC machine tools, operating across 44 countries and serving aerospace, automotive, and industrial sectors globally. I joined as a software engineering intern, working directly on internal enterprise systems used to manage the company's machine inventory and operations.

This was where I first built production-grade software at scale — designing data-driven applications, writing complex database logic, and delivering end-to-end features under real engineering standards.

▸ Delivered a full MVC-based Machines Management System in ASP.NET using Razor, replacing manual tracking with a structured, data-driven internal platform
▸ Designed and implemented custom DevExpress Control themes, delivering a consistent and professional UI across the system's reporting and charting surfaces
▸ Built Windows and Web Forms with User Controls using ASP.NET, C#, and JavaScript — handling the full UI layer of the management system
▸ Engineered ETL pipelines using SSIS and DTS Import/Export to extract, transform, and load operational machine data, ensuring clean and reliable data across systems
▸ Authored complex T-SQL including DDL and DML statements, stored procedures, and views in SQL Server 2008 — establishing the full relational data model for the system
▸ Used SQL Profiler to monitor and diagnose query execution, identifying bottlenecks and optimizing performance of critical database operations
▸ Implemented DevExpress controls with MVC 4 Razor and LINQ for dynamic reports and charts, giving operations teams real-time visibility into machine data
▸ Delivered automated Email and SMS notification system to alert stakeholders of machine status events, reducing manual follow-up overhead

Stack: ASP.NET MVC 4, C#, Razor, JavaScript, DevExpress Controls, SQL Server 2008, T-SQL, SSIS, DTS, LINQ, Stored Procedures, Windows Forms, Web Forms

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
▸ Involved in creating 3 tier .Net application using ASP.Net using C#.
▸ Involved in creating POCs on various part of application.
▸ Effectively created Windows service, WCF, Web API (REST), Web services.
▸ Involve in learning and implementing HTML5 and CSS, Telerik controls.
▸ Involved in creating stored procedure using MS SQL Server 2008, MS SQL Server 2012 
▸ Attended seminars related to Software Engineer's etiquettes.
▸ Implemented client side logic using JavaScript, JQuery
▸ Effectively created Web service.
▸ Used JQuery library for client side development.

▸ Effectively created website using C# and ASP.Net
▸ Effectively used and learned Entity Framework 4.0, LINQ to communicate with MS SQL server 2008 as database.
▸ Successfully designed and developed various Web forms and Class Libraries in .Net & C#.
